records.fresh_source_gloss: Have you heard? They say the princess is going to become engaged.
records.source_Japanese:
ちょっとお聞きになりました？

records.source_meaning: Have you heard? They say the princess is going to become engaged.
records.english: {SPEAKER:A6}Have you heard? They say the princess is getting engaged!
records.speaker: Lady
records.context:
Read all eight speeches as one courteous,animated gossip exchange. A6 asks whether A7 has heard that the princess is going to become engaged. A7 responds with the reported identity of the partner as the duke's son. A6 repeats an extravagant report that the engagement ring costs enough to buy a mountain. A7 treats that as characteristic of the duke,then wonders when they can see the princess wearing the jewel. A6 predicts that this will not be far off and that more women will want that gemstone afterward. A7 reacts with urgency:waiting until the fashion has caught on would be too late,and asks what the gemstone is and whether A6 knows. A6 admits she does not know and proposes going to ask right away. Preserve the comic contrast between elaborate gossip and their lack of the basic gemstone identity. The closing impersonal FE forecasts 宝石 becoming fashionable in ロンドン.

Princess,duke and the duke's son are explicit source ranks and kinship;preserve them rather than deleting them under a generic no-invented-ranks rule. No royal name,ducal name,house,nationality,player-character identity,age,political motive or marriage date is established. The son is the reported future engagement partner,not an already married husband. The engagement and remarkable ring price are hearsay;do not convert them to verified narrator facts or a completed wedding. The mountain price is deliberate hyperbole and should remain expressive,without inventing a currency or numerical price. The source does not identify the gemstone;do not inherit Ruby from B181,guess diamonds,or assert that the princess has already worn it. The speakers anticipate imitation after seeing her wear it;this is dialogue about a possible fashion,not a proved active shortage,price rise,profit or demand-system mechanic. London is named only in the closing forecast and does not establish the preceding scene location.

Preserve the two speakers' courtesy,shared gossip,admiration,curiosity,prediction and competitive urgency,then the revealing admission and intention to ask. A6's prediction about women wanting the gem is confident character speech;the final FE remains prospective. records.context:
Read all eight speeches as one courteous,animated gossip exchange. A6 asks whether A7 has heard that the princess is going to become engaged. A7 responds with the reported identity of the partner as the duke's son. A6 repeats an extravagant report that the engagement ring costs enough to buy a mountain. A7 treats that as characteristic of the duke,then wonders when they can see the princess wearing the jewel. A6 predicts that this will not be far off and that more women will want that gemstone afterward. A7 reacts with urgency:waiting until the fashion has caught on would be too late,and asks what the gemstone is and whether A6 knows. A6 admits she does not know and proposes going to ask right away. Preserve the comic contrast between elaborate gossip and their lack of the basic gemstone identity. The closing impersonal FE forecasts 宝石 becoming fashionable in ロンドン.

Princess,duke and the duke's son are explicit source ranks and kinship;preserve them rather than deleting them under a generic no-invented-ranks rule. No royal name,ducal name,house,nationality,player-character identity,age,political motive or marriage date is established. The son is the reported future engagement partner,not an already married husband. The engagement and remarkable ring price are hearsay;do not convert them to verified narrator facts or a completed wedding. The mountain price is deliberate hyperbole and should remain expressive,without inventing a currency or numerical price. The source does not identify the gemstone;do not inherit Ruby from B181,guess diamonds,or assert that the princess has already worn it. The speakers anticipate imitation after seeing her wear it;this is dialogue about a possible fashion,not a proved active shortage,price rise,profit or demand-system mechanic. London is named only in the closing forecast and does not establish the preceding scene location.

Preserve the two speakers' courtesy,shared gossip,admiration,curiosity,prediction and competitive urgency,then the revealing admission and intention to ask. A6's prediction about women wanting the gem is confident character speech;the final FE remains prospective.
